select
    cast(company_id as integer) as company_id,
    upper(trim(ticker)) as ticker,
    company_name,
    sector,
    industry,
    country,
    cast(listing_date as date) as listing_date
from read_parquet('data/silver/companies_clean/*.parquet')

select
    cast(company_id as varchar) || '-' || cast(date as varchar) as daily_price_key,
    cast(company_id as integer) as company_id,
    cast(date as date) as price_date,
    cast(close_price as double) as close_price,
    cast(volume as bigint) as volume,
    cast(daily_return as double) as daily_return,
    cast(moving_average_20d as double) as moving_average_20d,
    cast(rolling_volatility_20d as double) as rolling_volatility_20d,
    ticker,
    company_name,
    sector,
    industry,
    country
from read_parquet('data/silver/daily_price_features/*.parquet')

select
    cast(company_id as varchar) || '-' || fiscal_quarter as company_quarter_key,
    cast(company_id as integer) as company_id,
    fiscal_quarter,
    cast(fiscal_quarter_start_date as date) as fiscal_quarter_start_date,
    cast(available_date as date) as available_date,
    cast(feature_available_date as date) as feature_available_date,
    cast(revenue as double) as revenue,
    cast(gross_profit as double) as gross_profit,
    cast(operating_income as double) as operating_income,
    cast(net_income as double) as net_income,
    cast(total_assets as double) as total_assets,
    cast(total_liabilities as double) as total_liabilities,
    cast(equity as double) as equity,
    cast(operating_cash_flow as double) as operating_cash_flow,
    cast(previous_quarter_revenue as double) as previous_quarter_revenue,

    ticker,
    company_name,

    country
from read_parquet('data/silver/quarterly_fundamental_features/*.parquet')

with daily_prices as (
    select
        company_id,
        ticker,
        company_name,
        sector,
        industry,
        country,
        price_date,
        close_price,
        volume,
        daily_return,
        moving_average_20d,
        rolling_volatility_20d,
        date_trunc('quarter', price_date) as fiscal_quarter_start_date
    from "finance_analytics"."finance"."stg_daily_prices"
),

quarterly_aggregates as (
    select
        cast(company_id as varchar) || '-' || cast(fiscal_quarter_start_date as varchar) as company_quarter_feature_key,
        company_id,
        ticker,
        company_name,
        sector,
        industry,
        country,
        fiscal_quarter_start_date,
        avg(close_price) as average_close_price,
        max(close_price) as quarter_high_close_price,
        min(close_price) as quarter_low_close_price,
        avg(daily_return) as average_daily_return,
        avg(volume) as average_volume,
        avg(moving_average_20d) as average_moving_average_20d,
        avg(rolling_volatility_20d) as average_rolling_volatility_20d
    from daily_prices
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
),

quarter_end_prices as (
    select
        company_id,
        fiscal_quarter_start_date,
        close_price as quarter_end_close_price,
        row_number() over (
            partition by company_id, fiscal_quarter_start_date
            order by price_date desc
        ) as quarter_end_rank
    from daily_prices
)

select
    quarterly_aggregates.company_quarter_feature_key,
    quarterly_aggregates.company_id,
    quarterly_aggregates.ticker,
    quarterly_aggregates.company_name,
    quarterly_aggregates.sector,
    quarterly_aggregates.industry,
    quarterly_aggregates.country,
    quarterly_aggregates.fiscal_quarter_start_date,
    quarterly_aggregates.average_close_price,
    quarterly_aggregates.quarter_high_close_price,
    quarterly_aggregates.quarter_low_close_price,
    quarter_end_prices.quarter_end_close_price,
    quarterly_aggregates.average_daily_return,
    quarterly_aggregates.average_volume,
    quarterly_aggregates.average_moving_average_20d,
    quarterly_aggregates.average_rolling_volatility_20d
from quarterly_aggregates
left join quarter_end_prices
    on quarterly_aggregates.company_id = quarter_end_prices.company_id
   and quarterly_aggregates.fiscal_quarter_start_date = quarter_end_prices.fiscal_quarter_start_date
   and quarter_end_prices.quarter_end_rank = 1

with history as (
    select *,
        lag(fiscal_quarter_start_date) over company_quarters as prior_date,
        lag(revenue) over company_quarters as prior_revenue,
        lag(available_date) over company_quarters as prior_available_date
    from "finance_analytics"."finance"."stg_quarterly_fundamentals"
    window company_quarters as (partition by company_id order by fiscal_quarter_start_date)
)
select company_quarter_key
from history
where not regexp_full_match(fiscal_quarter, '[0-9]{4}-Q[1-4]')
   or fiscal_quarter_start_date is null
   or fiscal_quarter <> strftime(fiscal_quarter_start_date, '%Y') || '-Q' || quarter(fiscal_quarter_start_date)
   or available_date is null or feature_available_date is null
   or available_date < last_day(fiscal_quarter_start_date + interval '2 months')
   or feature_available_date < available_date
   or (previous_quarter_revenue is not null and
       (prior_date is distinct from fiscal_quarter_start_date - interval '3 months'
        or previous_quarter_revenue is distinct from prior_revenue
        or feature_available_date < prior_available_date))
   or (prior_date is distinct from fiscal_quarter_start_date - interval '3 months'
       and revenue_growth_qoq is not null)
   or (prior_date = fiscal_quarter_start_date - interval '3 months'
       and previous_quarter_revenue is distinct from prior_revenue)

with base as (
    select
        company_quarter_key,
        company_id,
        ticker,
        sector,
        industry,
        country,
        fiscal_quarter,
        fiscal_quarter_start_date,
        feature_available_date,
        revenue_growth_qoq,
        gross_margin,
        operating_margin,
        net_margin,
        debt_to_equity,
        return_on_assets,
        cash_flow_margin,
        asset_turnover,
        average_daily_return,
        average_volume,
        average_moving_average_20d,
        average_rolling_volatility_20d,
        quarter_end_close_price
    from "finance_analytics"."finance"."mart_company_quarterly_metrics"
),

outcomes as (
    select
        *,
        lead(fiscal_quarter_start_date) over company_quarters as next_observed_quarter,
        lead(revenue_growth_qoq) over company_quarters as next_observed_growth,
        lead(feature_available_date) over company_quarters as next_observed_available_date
    from base
    window company_quarters as (partition by company_id order by fiscal_quarter_start_date)
),

labeled as (
    select
        * exclude (next_observed_quarter, next_observed_growth, next_observed_available_date),
        case when next_observed_quarter = fiscal_quarter_start_date + interval '3 months'
            then next_observed_growth end as next_quarter_revenue_growth_qoq,
        case when next_observed_quarter = fiscal_quarter_start_date + interval '3 months'
             and next_observed_growth is not null
            then next_observed_available_date end as next_quarter_outcome_available_date
    from outcomes
)

select
    *,
    case
        when next_quarter_revenue_growth_qoq is null then null
        when next_quarter_revenue_growth_qoq > 0 then 1
        else 0
    end as next_quarter_growth_flag,
    next_quarter_revenue_growth_qoq is not null
        and next_quarter_outcome_available_date > feature_available_date as is_training_eligible
from labeled

select
    sector || '-' || cast(fiscal_quarter_start_date as varchar) as sector_quarter_key,
    sector,
    fiscal_quarter,
    fiscal_quarter_start_date,
    count(distinct company_id) as company_count,
    avg(revenue_growth_qoq) as average_revenue_growth_qoq,
    avg(gross_margin) as average_gross_margin,
    avg(operating_margin) as average_operating_margin,
    avg(net_margin) as average_net_margin,
    avg(debt_to_equity) as average_debt_to_equity,

    select
        next_quarter_growth_flag as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "finance_analytics"."finance"."mart_ml_ready_features"
    group by next_quarter_growth_flag

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    0,1
)

-- Unknown/gapped outcomes must never become negative training examples.
select features.company_quarter_key
from "finance_analytics"."finance"."mart_ml_ready_features" as features
left join "finance_analytics"."finance"."mart_company_quarterly_metrics" as next_quarter
    on features.company_id = next_quarter.company_id
   and next_quarter.fiscal_quarter_start_date = features.fiscal_quarter_start_date + interval '3 months'
where features.next_quarter_revenue_growth_qoq is distinct from next_quarter.revenue_growth_qoq
   or features.next_quarter_growth_flag is distinct from
       case when next_quarter.revenue_growth_qoq is null then null
            when next_quarter.revenue_growth_qoq > 0 then 1 else 0 end
   or features.next_quarter_outcome_available_date is distinct from
       case when next_quarter.revenue_growth_qoq is not null then next_quarter.feature_available_date end
   or features.is_training_eligible is distinct from
       (next_quarter.revenue_growth_qoq is not null
        and next_quarter.feature_available_date > features.feature_available_date)
